title: Levi's Women's 725 High Rise Bootcut Jeans (Black Stretch)

comparisons.notes: Same Levi's 725 high-rise stretch bootcut model, Soft Black wash, sale price via Google Shopping listing
Same Levi's 725 High Rise Bootcut women's jeans, listed in stock at regular price

writeup: Woot has Levi's 725 High Rise Bootcut Jeans in Black (Stretch) for $17.99, new condition, in sizes 29, 30 and 31. The same 725 bootcut runs $47.22 on sale at Macy's and $74.95 at Kohl's, so this is about 61% below the cheapest store price we found. Limit 10 per customer, and the size run is narrow.
